violations.why: Timer_C (prio 4) can preempt Timer_A between its read and write of timerCount, causing a lost update.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_A and reset timerCount between the two reads, so they see different values.
Timer_C can overwrite timerCount after Timer_A writes it and before Timer_A's check, so the check no longer sees the value Timer_A wrote.
Timer_A (prio 3) can preempt Timer_B between its write of 0 and its check, so the check can see a changed value.
Timer_C (prio 4) can preempt Timer_B between its write and read, and it writes timerCount.
Timer_Force (prio 3) can preempt Timer_B between its write of 0 and its check, and sets timerCount to 1, so the check fails.
